Jake (Helio): hi team — HelioDynamics here. We want to onboard a composite pipeline: 13B summarizer -> 3B reranker -> embeddings store. Must run in our VPC, keys behind HSM, and the data includes PHI. Pilot target: ~4 weeks, production after validation. Can you outline deliverables, eval plan, and infra needs?

Marta (CS): thanks Jake — got it. Quick q: do you need Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) or Private (on-prem/VPC) with our private control plane? Any firm latency/throughput goals?

Jake (Helio): private control plane + VPC peering is required. Prefer Dedicated GPUs behind the VPC for predictability. SLOs: reranker p99 < 300ms, end-to-end summarization < 600ms for 1024 tokens. Target throughput ~200 req/s for reranker, batchy summarizer can be lower. Quantization okay if we certify no degradation to recall. We'll share sample prompts and a redacted dataset (~5k records).

Kevin (Solutions): got it — we'll propose an eval harness. Plan: (1) baseline on hosted Redwood model variants, (2) run private canary on Dedicated with your sample set, (3) metrics: recall@1/5, MRR, hallucination rate (manual spot-check), latency p50/p95/p99, false redaction rate. Do you have an acceptance threshold for hallucinations?

Jake (Helio): aiming <1% hallucination on clinical prompts and >95% recall@1 for reranker on our labelled set. Also need strict audit log retention for PHI access.

Amelia (Infra): infra notes — we'll need: VPC peering (private control plane), subnets for inference pods, internal LB, NAT for updates only, and CloudHSM or external HSM integration. For Dedicated sizing I suggest `4 x a10x` for the 13B summarizer with mixed-precision + `2 x a2` for the 3B reranker; adjust once we run perf tests. Sample config snippet for intake: 
```
resource_request: 
  summarizer: gpu:4, type:a10x, memory:192GB
  reranker: gpu:2, type:a2, memory:64GB
network: 
  vpc: peer-enabled
  hsm: aws-cloudhsm or customer-hsm
```
We also need an IAM role and a KMS policy for key usage audit.

Jake (Helio): thanks — can you also surface cost ballpark for pilot vs production? And do you support token redaction hooks for PHI before logs leave the VPC?

Kevin (Solutions): yes, we can run token-filtering hooks in the private plane. I'll put together a pilot cost estimate (compute + storage + Dedicated reservation delta) and a checklist for HSM options.

deploy-bot: New intake created: CS-9876 (HelioDynamics composite LLM intake) — assigned Marta.

Marta (CS): I'll coordinate kickoff and book a 30m kickoff for Wed 10am PT. @Kevin @Amelia please prepare an eval plan and infra checklist ahead of the call. Jake — please upload the sample prompts and the redacted dataset link to the ticket (CS-9876) so we can spin up the canary next week. :thumbsup:
